mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.row_version,s.created_at,s.updated_at,s.chapter_id,s.order_index,s.title,s.narration,s.duration_seconds,s.status FROM scenes s JOIN chapters c ON c.id=s.chapter_id WHERE c.id=#{chapterId} AND s.storyboard_revision_id=c.current_storyboard_revision_id ORDER BY s.order_index,s.id

SELECT id,row_version,created_at,updated_at,scene_id,order_index,title,visual_intent,review_status,motion_mode,camera_movement,aspect_ratio_override,quality_tier_override,preview_asset_id FROM visual_beats WHERE scene_id IN #{id} ORDER BY scene_id,order_index,id
SELECT id,row_version,created_at,updated_at,chapter_id,order_index,title,narration,duration_seconds,status FROM scenes WHERE id=#{id} AND chapter_id=#{chapterId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(order_index),-1) FROM visual_beats WHERE scene_id=#{sceneId}

INSERT INTO visual_beats (row_version,created_at,updated_at,scene_id,order_index,title,visual_intent,review_status,motion_mode,camera_movement,aspect_ratio_override,quality_tier_override,preview_asset_id) VALUES (#{rowVersion},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{sceneId},#{orderIndex},#{title},#{visualIntent},#{reviewStatus},#{motionMode},#{cameraMovement},#{aspectRatioOverride},#{qualityTierOverride},#{previewAssetId}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE visual_beats SET title=#{title},visual_intent=#{visualIntent},review_status=#{reviewStatus},motion_mode=#{motionMode},camera_movement=#{cameraMovement},aspect_ratio_override=#{aspectRatioOverride},quality_tier_override=#{qualityTierOverride},updated_at=#{updatedAt},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
